newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Yugoslav June producer prices 0.4 pct down on May.
newsitem.headline: Yugoslav June producer prices 0.4 pct down on May.

text.p: The Federal Statistics Office reported the following economic indicator details.
YUGOSLAV PRODUCER PRICES JUNE MAY JUNE 96
NOTES -- Cumulative January-June PPI rose 26.0 percent against the same period last year and was 18.1 percent up against the average in 1996.
June PPI rose 18.7 percent against the average for 1996 and was 4.7 percent up on December last year.
Figures refer to the Federal Republic of Yugoslavia, comprising Serbia and Montenegro. -- Amra Kevic, Belgrade newsroom +381 11 311 4305
